 1. "They hate our freedom." 
 2. "They're jealous of our way of life." 
 3. "They're barbarians."

This simplification not only simplistically answers the question but also gives permission for us to disregard, dehumanize, and demonize those who are part of the conflict.

RelatedGlaucoma is a group of eye conditions that damage the optic nerve, which carries visual information from the eye to the brain. It is often associated with increased pressure in the eye, though not all types of glaucoma are caused by pressure. Glaucoma can lead to vision loss and even blindness if untreated . There are usually few or no symptoms in the early stages of glaucoma.
